study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used B-spline Bayesian linear regression (B-BLR) implemented in PCNtoolkit for normative modeling. For each brain region, an age-related normative model was estimated to predict regional GMV as a function of age and sex plus nuisance covariate TIV.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: for each brain region, we estimated an age-related normative model with datasets II and III (n = 510 + 229 = 739) (Figure 1B, top) to predict regional GMV as a function of age and sex plus nuisance covariate TIV using a B-spline Bayesian linear regression
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Shao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling and Individual Deviations

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter volume (GMV) of each brain region was estimated based on the Automated Anatomical Labeling (AAL) atlas (90 brain regions). The GMV was obtained from T1-weighted structural MRI images preprocessed with CAT12 toolkit.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: After all T1 images were preprocessed, the GMV of each brain region was estimated based on the Automated Anatomical Labeling atlas

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model used age and sex as main explanatory variables, with total intracranial volume (TIV) as a nuisance covariate. B-spline basis functions were applied to model the age-related trajectory.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: to predict regional GMV as a function of age and sex plus nuisance covariate TIV using a B-spline Bayesian linear regression
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Shao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling and Individual Deviations
